crime.value: Serial murder: seven victims killed by an unknown red-haired male; central question—how will the killer be apprehended when he eludes police roadblocks and grows bolder with each kill?
crime.quote: So far they found seven of his victims... The police got all the roads blocked for fifty miles around Edmonton.

victim.value: Multiple victims including a five-year-old child; killable because they were random targets selected after the first murder, when the killer's inhibitions dissolved and victims became interchangeable.
victim.quote: One of those killed was a boy of five... After the first few, it doesn't matter. You get to like it.

closed_world.value: A remote highway corridor near Edmonton, Alberta, spanning fifty miles with police blockades; the flat plain with sparse gas stations creates isolation where the killer and his victims are confined to a linear geography.
closed_world.quote: The long flat road... the road stretched ahead of us and on both sides there was nothing but the flat plain. Not a house. Not a tree.

culprit_and_motive.value: The red-haired seventeen-year-old hitchhiker is the serial killer, motivated by psychological rage—he was bullied and dominated his entire life and 'exploded' into violence to become powerful and feared.
culprit_and_motive.quote: Somebody was always there to tell him what to do... He exploded. A guy can take just so much. Then something's got to give.

resolution.value: The narrator—the actual killer, disguised as an ordinary driver—uses the hitchhiker's own resemblance to the wanted description to trap and murder him, becoming victim #8 while escaping suspicion.
resolution.quote: He was going to be number eight.

investigator.value: The protagonist narrator, who is himself the serial killer, serves as the lens through which the reader experiences the mystery; his perspective creates dramatic irony as the hitchhiker unknowingly reveals the killer's psychology.
investigator.quote: I took one hand off the wheel and rubbed the back of my neck... I thought I'd find you somewhere on this highway.
